feature: IN-list membership predicates in WHERE clauses

scenarios.name: IN matches rows whose data-lane value is a listed member
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/list (IN membership on a value)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind IN ["neighbor"] RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: IN with several numeric members matches any of them
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/list (IN over multiple numeric members)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score IN [10, 30] RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: IN with a single-element list matches just that value
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind IN ["island"] RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: IN with an empty list matches nothing
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind IN [] RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: IN list containing null — null is not a member, other values still match
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score IN [null, 20] RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: IN on a spine field with element-level params
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/list (IN with parameterized members)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.entity_id IN [$first, $second] RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: IN narrows the aggregation path before the COUNT
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/list (IN filter applied before aggregation)
scenarios.query: MATCH (h)-[:PG_LINKS]->(n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind IN ["neighbor"] RETURN h.entity_id AS src, COUNT(n) AS c

scenarios.name: IN composes with AND
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/list (IN composed with AND)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.kind IN ["island"] AND n.data.severity_score > 10 RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id
